name: Venomancer: enemies outside Shadra's Lair cannot target the Venomancer inside it (#8348)
contract: #8348: Shadra's Lair 804978 (cast in Spider Form 800841, which gives its required caster aura 803184) reads 'Designate the area around you as your Lair for $d. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the Lair and their movement speed is slowed by $s1%.' Its three SPELL_EFFECT_PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA effects use radius index 14 (8 yd): effect 0 slows enemies (TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY), effect 1 marks enemies and effect 2 marks allies (EffectImplicitTargetA TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ALLY, TargetB unset). The Lair check needs the attacker or the target to carry the aura, so the Venomancer inside must carry it from effect 2. A hostile dummy 4 yd away is inside the Lair and one 25 yd away is outside. The outside dummy must not be able to aim the single-target Frostbolt 116 at the Venomancer while the inside dummy still can, and both keep the Venomancer as a valid melee/threat target so the Lair never makes a creature evade.

steps.label: SETUP: the Lair's required Beetle or Spider Form aura is on
CONTROL: before the Lair the outside dummy can aim Frostbolt at the Venomancer
SETUP: the Lair ground effect exists
CONTROL: the dummy inside the Lair carries its enemy aura
CONTROL: the dummy outside the Lair carries no Lair aura
DISCRIMINATING: the Venomancer inside her Lair carries its ally aura
DISCRIMINATING: the outside dummy cannot aim Frostbolt into the Lair
CONTROL: the inside dummy can still aim Frostbolt at the Venomancer
GUARD: the outside dummy keeps the Venomancer as a valid threat target (no evade)
